lines.en: I come along the ridge.
I leave prints in the snow.
I climb across the rock.

lines.zh: 我压低身体在林子里挪。
lines.en: I move low through the pines.
I close on you step by step.
I go around a big boulder.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很长，拖在身后。
lines.en: My long tail trails behind me.
I walk the treeline.
The branches make no sound under me.
I slowly turn my body.
I move along the rock face.
I advance a step at a time.
I lie on the rock, still.
My ears turn slowly.
I listen in the pines.
I lie there, tail hanging.
I wait for you to relax.

lines.zh: 我伏在冷山脊上，等羊群。
lines.en: On the cold ridge I wait for sheep.
I lower my head.
The muscle on my shoulder is tense.
I rest a while on the slope.
I look straight down at you from the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有一点退让。
lines.en: My eyes give nothing away.
I am measuring the distance.
One more step, and I go for your throat.
I slowly lower my upper body.
My tail tip sways.

lines.zh: 我沿山脊走过来，雪上留一串印。
lines.en: I come along the ridge, leaving prints in the snow.
I am looking at your throat.
I make a low sound.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到别的味道。
lines.en: I smell other things on you.
I stare, teeth showing.
I retreat behind a rock.
My ears flatten back.
I'm used to chasing mountain sheep.
I do not turn to run.

lines.zh: 呜！山风都盖不住这一下。
lines.en: Hss! Even the mountain wind can't hide that hit.
My claws are numb, but I'm not backing down.
Wounds sting worse in these cold hills.
I glance with no interest.

lines.zh: 我不吃放在地上的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what is left on the ground.
I circle the thing once.
I sniff it and wrinkle my nose.
I pick it up and set it down.
I look up at you, displeased.
I flick that piece aside with a paw.
I step back twice.
You hit me and I stay like stone.
I raise a paw to block.
I did not yield; you did.
We land a muffled thud.
I slowly settle my weight lower.
My fur stands up.
My shoulder knocks you aside.
You hit me as if hitting rock.
I stare at you, displeased.

lines.zh: 两只美洲狮在山脊上相遇。
lines.en: Two cougars meet on the ridge.
It licks my neck.
We lie on the rock together.
It walks slowly around me.

lines.zh: 我们一起盯着山下的动静。
lines.en: We watch the valley below together.
Neither of us shifts.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印并排留在雪上。
lines.en: Our tracks lie side by side in the snow.

lines.zh: 它们一起往林子深处走。
lines.en: They head into the pines together.
I bite it and hide it behind the rock.
I press it into the snow.
I drag it a few steps.
I hide it behind a rock.
I look and drop it.
I lift my head with it.
I drag it up the slope.
I carry it behind a snowbank.
I paw at it.

lines.zh: 我的头慢慢转过来，雪山的风在吹。
lines.en: My head turns slowly; the snow mountain wind blows.
I am fixed on it, motionless.
I take the first step.
I did not make a sound.
I have found its flank.
I lie very low.
This distance is close enough.
I press forward step by step.
I slip out from behind the rock.
I leave new prints in the snow.
This stretch is mine to rule.
I begin rushing at it.

lines.zh: 寒冷山地上，羊都是我的。
lines.en: On cold mountains, the sheep are mine.
I watch no longer.
I follow it the whole way.
Wherever it runs, I am behind.
I follow low along the ground.
I am not fast, yet I never stop.
I weave between the rocks.
I stay downwind.
I shorten that stretch of ground.
My steps in the snow are light.
I lie low in the snow, waiting for it to look back.
It has taken off running.
I take a shorter route.
Only three blocks between us.
I flatten myself as far as I can.
I press forward an inch at a time.
My tail pulls straight behind.
I could spring at any moment.
I am counting the distance.
I leap and bite its neck.
My paw rakes it.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌把它的头按下去。
lines.en: I slam its head down with a paw.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞上来，不打招呼。
lines.en: I hit from the side, no greeting.
It is pinned in the snow.
I bite and will not let go.
It breaks free and I pounce again.
I shake my head and tear.
It backs off; I block it.
I press down, heavy.
My teeth are very sharp.
It rolls down the slope.
I follow it step for step.
Every sheep on this cold mountain is mine to watch.
It turns to face me.
My forepaw presses its back.
I seize the hind leg and drag it down.
I press it into the snow.
I cuff it across the face.

lines.zh: 山脊上多了一只长尾的影子。
lines.en: A long-tailed shadow appears on the ridge.
I come out from behind the rock.
A line of prints appears in the snow.
I begin patrolling this area.
You hear movement in the trees.
I stand at the treeline.
My eyes glint first.

lines.zh: 我从松林里慢慢走出来。
lines.en: I come slowly out of the pines.
A chill runs down your back.
I stop on the slope and watch you.
My long tail shows first.
I start down the slope.
Fire catches my fur and I leap back.

lines.zh: 我从山脊摔下，落在雪里。
lines.en: I fall from the ridge into the snow.
Water slows me down badly.

lines.zh: 爆声把我震得贴在地上。
lines.en: The blast pins me to the ground.
The shaft quivers in my shoulder; I growl low.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的腿锁住。
lines.en: That force locks my legs.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只缩起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I curl up.

lines.zh: 脚下的山没了，我坠下去。
lines.en: The mountain is gone; I fall.
